characters.name: Suzette
characters.role: Cyborg neighbour whose invitation and stated wishes drive the central relationship.

selectionEvidence.quote: Her black hair swept outward in two sharp wings
selectionEvidence.explanation: Introduced with explicit humanoid cyborg appearance and equipment.

selectionEvidence.quote: I want you to dance badly with me.
selectionEvidence.explanation: Her request resolves the main emotional action.

storyAppearance.anatomy: Humanlike brown skin, silver seams before ears, mechanical joints beneath gloves, silver ankle articulations; large dark irises and emphatic lashes.
storyAppearance.proportions: Adult woman, stylized large eyes, otherwise human proportions.
storyAppearance.markings: Persistent pink/red blush; fine silver seams before ears.
storyAppearance.materials: Brown skin over cyborg mechanism; polished silver joint edges beneath gloves/boots.
storyAppearance.clothing: First turquoise squared-shoulder mod minidress orange circles down one side, white cinch belt/gloves above elbow/near-knee boots. Later yellow dress black hem squares with black gloves and yellow belt; black-white rectangles with red belt/gloves; Saturday cherry-red mod dress narrow white collar-to-hem panel, red patent belt, white gloves/boots.
storyAppearance.equipment: Compact flashlight-size railgun in black molded holster at RIGHT hip, blue trigger-guard lock tab, dark charge window; stored before dancing.
storyAppearance.movement: Gentle mechanical joint adjustments; independent offbeat dancing, awkward kick then recovery.
storyAppearance.distinctiveFeatures: Black winged bob, brown blushing cheeks, very large dark irises/lashes, ear seams.

explicitCanon: Local non-canon story fact: Woman, cyborg, 28, brown skin, black hair in two wings, large dark irises/lashes.

Local non-canon story fact: Fingers segmented beneath gloves; silver ankle articulations; four described mod outfit combinations.
